ga-openstates-roster.title: Sitting Georgia legislators and statewide officials
ga-openstates-roster.note: Who holds each seat today, and which candidate is a sitting member (same chamber and district, the name fits, one fit only; the results' incumbent mark with the same family name is also taken, and listed; a member of another seat only when the name fits exactly one sitting legislator or official of the same party). Names, party and ids only.

ga-sos-2026-sl-primary-results.title: Georgia Election Results: May 19, 2026 - General Primary, Total Votes (official results): state offices
ga-sos-2026-sl-primary-results.note: The "Total Votes Excel" report of https://results.sos.ga.gov/results/public/Georgia/elections/GeneralPrimary51926, marked official on the results site; the same file the federal loader reads. 412 state contests read (statewide offices, Public Service Commission, State Senate, State House); each contest's Total Votes line equals the sum of its candidates, and every candidate's county figures add up to the statewide figure. The results carry no write-in line; the incumbent mark "(I)" is taken off the names. A field is a party primary with two candidates or more. Not on the November ballot and not stored: 8 appellate court seats elected on May 19 (nonpartisan), none of them in the June 16 runoff; superior court judges, district attorneys and the party questions are local or not offices.
